title: Shuru karne se pehle
intro: App kholne se lekar pehli entry tak. Yeh teen page padh lo, baaki sab apne aap samajh aa jayega.

pages.title: Login
pages.what: App khulte hi yeh screen aati hai. Email aur password wahi daalo jo maalik ne aapke liye banaya hai.
steps: EMAIL mein apna email likho — naam nahi, email.
PASSWORD daalo, phir “Kholo” dabao.
Password bhool gaye ho to neeche “Password bhool gaye?” par tap karo.
pages.note: Pehli baar login ke baad app saara maal aur khata phone mein utaar leta hai — ek-do minute lag sakte hain. Uske baad signal na ho tab bhi app poora chalta hai; net aate hi sab apne aap server par chala jaata hai.

pages.title: Ghar — pehli screen
pages.what: Din ka haal ek nazar mein. Upar do bade button, beech mein aaj ke number, neeche aaj kya-kya hua.
steps: “Bill Banao” — grahak ko maal de rahe ho to yahin se.
“Stock Chadhao” — supplier se maal aaya to yahin se.
AAJ KI SALE aur AAJ KA KHARCHA — aaj kitna bika, kitna paisa bahar gaya.
AAJ KA MUNAFA aur TOTAL STOCK — yeh do sirf maalik aur admin ko dikhte hain.
Neeche “AAJ KYA HUA” mein har entry time ke saath dikhti hai.
pages.note: Staff ke phone par kharid rate, munafa aur nuksan kahin nahi dikhta — yeh maalik ka hisaab hai. Munafa laal dikhe to iska matlab aaj kharcha sale se zyada hua.

pages.title: Laal “+ Nayi entry” — saare kaam yahin se
pages.what: Neeche daayein taraf laal button. Dabao to paanch kaam dikhte hain — jo aapka role kar sakta hai, sirf wahi.
steps: Stock Chadhao — supplier se naya maal aaya.
Bill Banao — grahak ko maal de rahe ho.
Kharcha Likho — dukaan ka paisa bahar gaya (chai, transport, bijli).
Kharab Likho — maal toot gaya, kharab nikla ya gum ho gaya.
Ginti Karo — shelf par gino, app se farak ho to theek karo.

title: Roz ka kaam
intro: Chaar kaam jo har din hote hain. Inhe theek se karoge to baaki hisaab apne aap sahi rehta hai.

pages.title: Stock Chadhao — naya maal
pages.what: Supplier se maal aaya. Kitna aaya aur kahan rakha, bas itna likhna hai — stock turant badh jaata hai.
steps: Supplier chuno. Naya supplier ho to naam likho aur “+ Naya banao” dabao.
Neeche maal scan karo ya naam likho, list mein se chuno.
“Kitne aaye” mein ginti daalo. Ek se zyada item ho to sab ek saath daal sakte ho.
Supplier ke bill ki photo lagani ho to “Bill ki photo” se lagao (zaroori nahi).
“… pcs chadha do” dabao.
pages.note: Staff ko kharid rate nahi bharna — rate maalik baad mein bharta hai. Item list mein nahi mil raha to “admin ko bhejo” dabao; approve hote hi wo item mil jayega.

pages.title: Bill Banao — maal dena
pages.what: Grahak ko maal de rahe ho. Grahak chuno, maal daalo, paisa kaise aaya chuno — bas.
steps: “Kaun le raha hai” mein grahak chuno. Naya ho to naam likho aur “+ Naya banao” — grahak banke wapas isi bill par aa jaata hai.
Maal scan karo ya naam likho. Har line par qty aur rate badal sakte ho.
“Paisa kaise aaya” — Cash, Online / UPI, Udhaar, Card ya Bank.
“Bill bana do” dabao, phir “Aage badho”.
Bill ban gaya to WhatsApp par parchi bhej sakte ho.
pages.note: Stock kam ho to app pehle poochhta hai “Phir bhi bill banayein?” — haan karoge to stock minus mein chala jayega, baad mein ginti se theek karo. Bina maal ke bill adhoora chhoda to wo apne aap hat jaata hai; maal daal ke chhoda to Bill tab ke “Adhoore bill” mein milega.

pages.title: Bana hua bill
pages.what: Bill kholne par sab kuch: kitne ka tha, kitna mila, kitna baaki, aur us bill par aage kya karna hai.
steps: “Jama laga do” — udhaar ka paisa aaya to yahin se. Paisa likhne ke baad wapas isi bill par aate ho.
“WhatsApp parchi” — grahak ko bill ki parchi bhejo.
“PDF / print” — bill print karo ya PDF share karo.
“Maal wapas” — grahak maal lauta raha hai. Bill ka maal pehle se bhara aata hai; jitna sach mein aaya utna rakho, kharab ho to “kharab” mark karo.

pages.title: Kharcha Likho
pages.what: Dukaan ka paisa bahar gaya — chai, transport, petrol, bijli. ₹40 ki chai bhi likho, tabhi din ka cash milega.
steps: Kitna kharcha hua — rakam daalo.
Kis cheez ka — chip dabao (Transport, Chai/Pani…).
Paisa kaise diya aur kisne diya chuno.
“₹… ka kharcha likh do” dabao.
pages.note: Partner ne apne liye paisa nikala to wo yahan nahi — “Aur” mein “Partner ka paisa likho” mein likho, wo dukaan ka kharcha nahi ginta.

title: Stock — maal ka hisaab
intro: Kahan kitna maal pada hai, kya khatam ho raha hai, kya toota — aur ginti kaise milayein.

pages.title: Stock tab — saara maal
pages.what: Upar har jagah ka maal (AutoLoom, Modern Car, Workshop, Damaged / Returns), neeche saara maal.
steps: Upar ke box mein SKU, barcode ya naam se dhoondo.
“Kam hai” — jo jaldi khatam hone wala hai. “Khatam” — jo bilkul nahi bacha.
Kisi item par tap karo to uska poora page khulta hai.

pages.title: Rate baaki — maalik ke liye
pages.what: Staff maal bina rate ke chadhate hain. Jis maal ka kharid rate abhi tak nahi bhara, wo yahan dikhta hai.
steps: Stock tab mein “Rate baaki” chip dabao (sirf maalik aur admin ko dikhti hai).
Item par tap karo, phir “Badlo”.
“Kharid rate” bharo aur “Badlav kar do” dabao.
pages.note: Rate bharne se pehle jo maal bik gaya uski cost ₹0 gini jaati hai, aur Hisab mein uska poora daam munafa dikhta hai. Isliye “Rate baaki” jaldi khaali karo.

pages.title: Item ka page
pages.what: Ek item ka sab kuch: kahan kitna pada hai, kis rate par bikta hai, kis gaadi mein lagta hai.
steps: “Kahan kitna pada hai” — har jagah ki ginti.
“Aana-jaana ka hisaab” — kab aaya, kab gaya, kisne kiya.
Maalik ko kharid rate aur margin bhi dikhta hai; staff ko nahi.

pages.title: Maal kahan pada hai
pages.what: Har jagah ka alag-alag maal. Kis jagah kya pada hai, ek nazar mein.

pages.title: Kharab Likho
pages.what: Maal toot gaya, kharab nikla ya gum ho gaya. Stock se nikal do taaki ginti sahi rahe.
steps: Wajah chuno — Kharab, Reject, Nahi mila, Toot gaya…
Maal scan karo ya naam likho, kitne kharab hain likho.
Photo lagani ho to lagao (zaroori nahi).
“… pcs kharab likh do” dabao, phir “Aage badho”.
pages.note: Godown wale bhi Kharab Likho kar sakte hain. Unhe rate ya nuksan nahi dikhta — wo maalik ke Hisab mein apne aap gina jaata hai.

pages.title: Ginti Karo — shelf se milana
pages.what: Shelf par jitna gina wo likho. App ke stock se farak ho to app theek kar deta hai.
steps: Maal scan karo ya naam likho.
“Ginti mein kitna nikla” — jitne gine wo likho. Farak upar dikh jaata hai.
Farak ki wajah chuno — Ginti galat thi, Kharab, Nahi mila, Aur kuch.
“… item theek kar do”, phir “Haan, ginti theek kar do”.

pages.title: Maal doosri jagah bhejo
pages.what: Godown se dukaan, dukaan se workshop — maal ek jagah se doosri jagah. Bhejte hi wahan chadh jaata hai.
steps: “Se” aur “Tak” chuno.
Maal scan karo ya naam likho, qty daalo.
“Bhej do” dabao, phir “Aage badho”.

pages.title: Kya mangwana hai
pages.what: Jo tezi se bik raha hai aur khatam hone wala hai, uski list — supplier ko order dene se pehle dekho.

title: Paisa aur khata
intro: Kisne kitna dena hai, paisa kab aaya, aur din ke aakhir mein kisko yaad dilana hai.

pages.title: Bill tab — din bhar ki entries
pages.what: Aaj ke saare bill, stock, kharcha aur paisa — time ke saath. Kal, 7 din, is mahine ya koi bhi tareekh chuno.
steps: Kisi bill par tap karo to wo bill khulta hai.
Upar “Adhoore bill” dikhe to wo bill poore nahi hue — tap karke poora karo ya “Chhod do”.

pages.title: Grahak ka khata
pages.what: Ek grahak ka poora hisaab: kitna baaki hai, kab kya liya, kab paisa diya.
steps: “Naya bill” — isi grahak ka bill banao.
“Paisa aa gaya” — grahak ne paisa diya.
“Yaad dilao” — WhatsApp par baaki ki yaad bhejo.
“Hisaab bhejo” — poora khata WhatsApp par bhejo.
Neeche khata: + jab udhaar badha, − jab paisa aaya, aur har line ke baad kitna baaki.

pages.title: Paisa aaya
pages.what: Grahak ne paisa diya. Rakam aur tareeka likho — app purane bill se pehle kaatta hai.
steps: Grahak chuno; “Poora paisa” dabao to poora baaki bhar jaata hai.
Kaise aaya — Cash, Online / UPI, Bank, Cheque, Card.
UPI ho to ref / UTR aur screenshot laga sakte ho (zaroori nahi).
“Paisa likh do”, phir “Aage badho”. Grahak ka mobile ho to app poochhega “WhatsApp par bhej dein?”.

pages.title: Yaad dilao
pages.what: Din ke aakhir mein: kisse kitna paisa lena hai, aur WhatsApp par yaad dilana.
steps: Upar kul baaki aur kitne grahak. “Aaj bill hua” ya “Der ho gayi” se chhaanto.
“Sabko bhejo” — har baar dabane par agle grahak ka WhatsApp khulta hai (WhatsApp ek baar mein ek hi chat kholta hai). Button batata hai “Agla bhejo · 2/5”.
Neeche aaj ke bill — har bill ki parchi alag se bhej sakte ho.
pages.note: Message aisa jaata hai: “AutoLoom ki taraf se yaad dila rahe hain. Aapka baaki: ₹… ”. Iska text Admin mein badal sakte ho.

pages.title: Hisab — kitna bacha
pages.what: Kisi bhi din, hafte ya mahine ka hisaab. Maalik ko poora: sale, maal ki cost, kharcha, kharab, munafa.
steps: Upar Aaj, 7 Din, Is Mahine ya apni tareekh chuno.
Kisi bhi line par tap karo to uske peeche ki entries khul jaati hain.
Maal wapas aaya to wo Sale aur cost dono se ghat jaata hai.
pages.note: Hisaab wale staff ko sirf Sale aur Kharcha dikhta hai. Maal ki cost, munafa aur nuksan sirf maalik aur admin dekhte hain.

title: Dhoondna aur gaadi
intro: Grahak counter par “Creta 2019 ka mat” bolta hai, SKU nahi. Isliye ek hi box mein sab dhoondho.

pages.title: Gaadi — kaunsa bulb, kaunsa maal
pages.what: “Aur” mein “Dhoondo” se gaadi ka naam likho (jaise “creta”), gaadi kholo.
steps: “Model aur bulb” — har model-saal ke saath headlight, fog ke socket (jaise Low Beam H7, Fog H8).
Kisi model-saal par tap karo to neeche sirf usi saal ka maal dikhta hai.
“Lagne wala maal” — is gaadi mein jo maal lagta hai, stock ke saath.

title: Maalik ke kaam
intro: Yeh screens sirf maalik aur admin ko dikhti hain.

pages.title: Admin
pages.what: Staff, approvals, maal aur dukaan ki settings — sab ek jagah. Approve karne wala kuch ho to sabse upar dikhta hai.

pages.title: Staff aur role
pages.what: Naya staff banao, role do, band karo. Ek aadmi ke ek se zyada role ho sakte hain.
steps: “+ Naya staff” — naam, email, password aur role.
Counter — bill aur paisa. Godown — maal lena, transfer, ginti, kharab likhna. Hisaab — khata aur paisa.
Kharid rate, munafa aur nuksan sirf Maalik aur Admin dekhte hain — kisi aur role ko nahi.

pages.title: Naya item
pages.what: Naam, qty aur bechne ka rate — bas itna kaafi hai. Gaadi, colour, kharid rate “Aur detail” mein.
steps: Category chuno ya nayi likho.
Item ka naam, qty aur bechne ka rate daalo.
Kharid rate yahin bharo — yahi se bikri ki cost aur munafa gine jaate hain.
“Item bana do” dabao. Purane item mein badlav ho to “Badlav kar do”.

pages.title: Naya maal ki requests
pages.what: Staff naya item khud nahi bana sakte — wo “Naya item bhejo” se bhejte hain, aur yahan approve hota hai.
steps: Request kholo, dekho, “Haan” ya “Mana” (mana karo to wajah likho).
Haan karte hi item ban jaata hai aur staff ko list mein mil jaata hai.

pages.title: Partner ka paisa
pages.what: Partner ne dukaan se paisa nikala — apne liye ya dukaan ke kaam ke liye. Dono alag likhe jaate hain, taaki dukaan ka kharcha aur partner ka nikala paisa mil na jaayein.

title: Baaki sab
intro: Jo roz nahi chahiye par kabhi-kabhi kaam aata hai.

pages.title: Aur
pages.what: Jo neeche ke tab mein nahi hai, wo sab yahan: Dhoondo, Yaad dilao, Grahak, Supplier, transfer, ginti, partner ka paisa, aur aapki jagah (kis dukaan/godown par ho).

pages.title: Grahak
pages.what: Saare grahak aur kiska kitna baaki. Dealer, Thok, Retail se chhaanto. Naya grahak yahin se bhi bana sakte ho.

pages.title: Supplier
pages.what: Saare supplier. Supplier kholo to usse aaya maal aur unke bill dikhte hain.

pages.title: Sync ka haal
pages.what: Phone ka data server tak gaya ya nahi. “JUDA HUA” dikhe to sab theek. Koi entry server ne mana ki ho to wo yahan aur ek laal message mein dikhti hai.

pages.title: Kaise chalayein — app ke andar hi
pages.what: Yahi manual app ke andar bhi hai: “Aur” mein “Kaise chalayein”. Kuch samajh na aaye to wahan dekho, ya maalik se poochho.
